tagline: Multi-jurisdictional gaming company operating 27 brick-and-mortar properties and online casino gaming
hero_kpi_rationale: Boyd Gaming completed the sale of its 5% stake in FanDuel for 1.758 billion dollars in July 2025, generating significant liquidity used to repay debt and strengthen the balance sheet

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues for the fiscal year
kpis.description: Total revenues increased by 161.8 million dollars from 2024 to 2025

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income for the fiscal year
kpis.description: Operating income decreased from 927.8 million dollars in 2024 to 748.4 million dollars in 2025

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income for the fiscal year
kpis.description: Net income increased significantly from 578.0 million dollars in 2024 to 1838.9 million dollars in 2025, benefiting from gains on the FanDuel equity sale

kpis.name: FanDuel Equity Sale
kpis.explanation: Sale of 5% equity interest in FanDuel Group to TSE Holdings Ltd.
kpis.description: On July 31, 2025, Boyd Interactive Holdings, a wholly owned subsidiary of Boyd Gaming, completed the sale of its 5% equity interest in FanDuel to TSE Holdings Ltd. for aggregate cash consideration of 1,758.0 million dollars. The proceeds were used primarily to repay outstanding borrowings under the Credit Facility
kpis.signal: Boyd Gaming completed the sale of its 5% equity interest in FanDuel for 1,758.0 million dollars on July 31, 2025
